title: Meh
text:
Meh. Unless I wanted to pay over $100, I have been unsuccessful in finding privacy curtains for 96” doors with glass panels. I used these curtains to sew my own. It probably would’ve been cheaper to buy the fabric by itself but I didn’t want to have to search for the right fabric or sew the hems on the sides. In other words, I’m lazy.

These curtains are not a true white, they have a slight yellow tinge. They’re almost ivory. They’re also 100% polyester so care instructions say not to bleach but I may explore this option. They give the perfect amount of light and privacy but the fabric reminds me of one of those reusable shopping bags. See photo. Now you can’t unsee it. You’re welcome. For additional comparison, I took a close up of another faux linen curtain I have hanging in my house that I love. For $21 and an hour or two of sewing, I may just retry with different curtains, but I’m lazy, so maybe I don’t care that much.
